Spacecraft PINO (Payload-IN-Orbit demonstration)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Organization NLR (Netherlands Aerospace Centre)
Institution Space agency
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)
Headquarters Netherlands
Oneliner

Thermal experiment involving a mechanically pumped two-phase heat transport system.
Description

A thermal experiment involving a mechanically pumped two-phase heat transport system using a stacked configuration of micro-pumps and an attitude experiment consisting of a small reaction wheel and a fibre optic gyroscope.
